requirements: R1: Fix calculation of deliverable readiness to correctly include ongoing task completions so it doesn't stagnate at 5/19 when 29 tasks are done.

slices.title: Patch deliverable readiness metric calculation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the readiness patch for this epic, I want to recalculate the metric dynamically using actual task completions, so that the stagnation warning is resolved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the deliverable readiness is being calculated
When multiple new tasks have been completed
Then the metric correctly reflects the new done tasks and is not stuck at previous values
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Stagnation warning false positive rate reduced to 0
